meta.note_zh: 本专区按主题聚合站内词条，术语定义与来源以词条详情页为准；案例拆解为教学示意。
meta.note_en: This zone aggregates on-site terms by topic. Definitions and references follow each term page; case walkthroughs are teaching illustrations.

topics.desc_zh: 从大脑取出可用信号：电极放在哪里、采什么物理量、信噪比与风险如何取舍。
topics.desc_en: Getting usable signals out of the brain: where electrodes sit, which physical quantity is measured, and how signal quality trades off against risk.

topics.desc_zh: 让用户「用哪种脑活动表达意图」：诱发响应、自主节律调制，还是多模态混合。
topics.desc_en: How a user expresses intent through brain activity: evoked responses, voluntary rhythm modulation, or hybrid multimodal control.

topics.desc_zh: 把原始波形变成可执行的指令：滤波、去伪迹、特征提取、分类或回归。
topics.desc_en: Turning raw waveforms into executable commands: filtering, artifact removal, feature extraction, classification or regression.

topics.desc_zh: 解码结果如何作用于外部设备，以及反馈如何回到用户形成闭环调控。
topics.desc_en: How decoded intent drives external devices, and how feedback returns to the user to close the loop.

topics.desc_zh: 植入风险、知情同意、神经数据隐私与医疗器械审批，决定技术能否真正落地。
topics.desc_en: Implant risk, informed consent, neural-data privacy and medical-device approval decide whether the technology can be deployed.

pipeline.desc_zh: 电极或光学传感器把神经电活动、磁场或血氧变化转成可记录的信号。
pipeline.desc_en: Electrodes or optical sensors convert neural electrical activity, magnetic fields or hemodynamics into recordable signals.

pipeline.desc_zh: 带通滤波、重参考、去伪迹与分段，尽量保留神经成分、压掉眼电肌电与工频干扰。
pipeline.desc_en: Band-pass filtering, re-referencing, artifact removal and epoching keep neural components while suppressing ocular, muscular and line noise.

pipeline.desc_zh: 把时域波形压缩成判别性特征：功率谱、ERD/ERS、空域滤波成分或锁时平均波形。
pipeline.desc_en: Compress time-domain waveforms into discriminative features: spectral power, ERD/ERS, spatial-filter components or time-locked averages.

pipeline.desc_zh: 用分类器或回归模型把特征映射为意图类别、连续轨迹或语音单元，并做在线校准。
pipeline.desc_en: Classifiers or regression models map features to intent classes, continuous trajectories or speech units, with online calibration.

pipeline.desc_zh: 指令驱动光标、机械臂、轮椅、外骨骼或语音合成器，完成一次可观察的行为。
pipeline.desc_en: Commands drive a cursor, robotic arm, wheelchair, exoskeleton or speech synthesizer to produce observable behavior.

pipeline.desc_zh: 把执行结果或神经状态回传给用户/刺激器，形成闭环并支持自适应调整。
pipeline.desc_en: Results or neural states are fed back to the user or stimulator, closing the loop and enabling adaptive adjustment.

cases.desc_zh: 字符矩阵随机闪烁，只有目标字符诱发 P300；逐轮累加即可选出字符。
cases.desc_en: Characters flash in a matrix; only the target evokes a P300, and accumulation across rounds selects the character.

cases.desc_zh: 多个指令以不同频率闪烁，注视哪个就增强对应频率的稳态响应。
cases.desc_en: Commands flicker at distinct frequencies; gazing at one amplifies the corresponding steady-state response.

cases.desc_zh: 想象肢体运动引起感觉运动节律去同步，解码后映射为假肢动作。
cases.desc_en: Imagined movement desynchronizes sensorimotor rhythms; decoding maps them to prosthetic actions.

cases.name_zh: 侵入式神经光标与语音
cases.desc_zh: 皮层内阵列记录峰电位，直接解码运动意图或构音过程。
cases.desc_en: Intracortical arrays record spikes and decode movement intent or articulation directly.
